The '''thunderhead hawk''' was a type of [[Hawk (animal)/Legends|hawk]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. A ground-based creature known as the [[Vrake (species)|vrake]], also native to Makeb, featured a head crest that greatly resembled the head of a thunderhead hawk, and vrakes used the crest to startle their prey&mdash;typically small [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] and birds&mdash;before pouncing on them.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thunderhead hawks were first mentioned in the Codex entry for vrakes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
